jurisdiction_name: WEST JEFFERSON WARD2 (WEST JEFFERSON VILLAGE Village)
narrative: West Jefferson Ward2 (Village of West Jefferson Village) has 756 registered voters, with 55.8% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 31.2% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 13.0%, a pronounced Republican lean of 18.3 percentage points.
